cue_definition: The fixed source-associated cuboid endpoint and3 true incident structural edge arms plus3 adjacent face patches. Expected cue identity is this endpoint/part convention, never arbitrary visible material nearq or any visible region of the whole part.
all8_q_L: Exact unchanged V96 AUX8 projected assemblyAABBcorner q/L. Custom lexicographic AUX index is NOT deployed native8 and not GT reference relocation.

patch_geometry.endpoint: Exact V96 associated source part vertex, no resnap/reassociation.
patch_geometry.true_edges: Flip exactly one min/max local source-coordinate at a time; transform with original USDrowmatrix. No triangle diagonal mistaken for edge.
patch_geometry.arm_length: min(.25*full source edge length, .02*assembly worldAABBdiagonal), independently on3 true edges.
patch_geometry.face_patch: For each incident local axis-normalface: endpoint and two incident truncated edge arms form a fixed planar quad.
patch_geometry.samples: Face9 (3x3 centres at1/6,1/2,5/6); each edge3 centres at1/6,1/2,5/6; exact endpoint once.37 source rays percue. These are bounded point/patch witnesses, not a full continuous photometric certification.

view_eligibility: Outward source face normal dot normalized(facecentroid→cameraeye)>1e-10. Back-facing/grazing faces are not eligible direct witnesses and do not veto an observable front-facing junction.1e-10 is a numerical grazing guard, not learned/selected.
witness: One eligible face9 plus its two adjacent edge3 sets plus endpoint. A complete direct witness can establish the geometric local cue even when other incident faces are naturally back-facing.

state_rules.D: At least one target-only direct witness remains fullyDIRECT after combined-scene rays. Other hidden/back-facing faces do not forceU.
state_rules.S: No direct witness; either every eligible witness is wholly target-self-blocked, or all3 faces are back-facing and every fixed endpoint/face/edge ray is target-self-blocked. Proxied under the all308-parts-target-assembly assumption.
state_rules.E: Target-onlyD established, then every original completeDIRECT witness is wholly foreign-occluded in the combined scene. A self-hidden cue is never promoted toE.
state_rules.U: No complete witness due partial self/foreign occlusion, grazing without certifiable witness, different-owner nearest ties, invalidgeometry, or full declared patch outside nativeframe/originalqLcrop. Raw geometric state and miss flags remain separate.
state_rules.partial_detail: A partially hidden witness is not used. A different, complete eligible witness still supportsD by this explicit observable-junction definition. Partial loss of all original direct witnesses without complete foreigncover givesU.

ray_rules: Own F64 opaque ray/triangle intersections, original winding/doubleSided, final-global-min ties64eps*max(1,distance). Same-owner face/triangle ties are not U; different-owner ties areU. Targetowners0..307; declared foreignowners>=308.

cover_target_before_new_render.reason: Preselected from V96 saved RGB clear outer top/side corner and direct endpoint-probe evidence; no native identity claim.
cover_target_before_new_render.cover_bound: Disk centred at projected physical endpoint with radius maxdistance to every face-patch quadvertex. Renderer may add fixed3px safety; disk is placement bound, not cue teacher.
cover_target_before_new_render.object: Same external opaque object/material/size/orientation/depth in cover+aside, exactq/L unchanged. Full patch/cue witnesses independently replay afterrender; do not force successful labels or moveobjectafterobservedteacher.

GT_input_separation: Expected part/patch/endpoint/rays/faceeligibility are GT-only teacher metadata. No masks, referencecoords, partID, nativeGTID, or branch label are forwarded. This preparation does not prove the present 3-input operator can identify a hidden expected cue.
current_C3: No procedural appearance/labels added to the already separate C3.
